title: Steel ring-frame internal forces

sourceOracles.coverage: Pinned steel ring-frame fixture and dependent plastic-hinge response context; the internal-force aggregator is exercised directly by the independent differential test because the source suite has no direct aggregator case.

independentValidation.method: Strict typed consumer declarations and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript comparison of assembled internal-force vectors, tangent stiffness matrices, state maps, hinge events, element response serialization, alias identity, Unicode, model/state selection and error paths.
independentValidation.fixture: Two independently constructed synthetic steel ring-frame elements sharing six global DOFs, with accumulated forces, stiffness contributions, hinge activation metadata, Unicode roles and state overrides.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON and enumerable result key order
tolerances.publicStrings: exact error, event metadata and Unicode code-point comparison
tolerances.errors: exact error name and message for missing frame, empty DOF registry and displacement-length mismatch

engineeringFunctionality: Strict TypeScript parity for the steel ring-frame internal-force and tangent-stiffness assembler; ring-frame builders, pushover models, solvers, analyses and public steel-frame barrel composition remain outside this slice.
